title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00032 — wellbore not published in this release

sections.text: POOH w/ guns from 147m to surface
L/d perforation guns BHA. All shots fired
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u cutter BHA
P/u and m/u cutter BHA
Removed master bushing and installed ps21
RIH w/ cutter BHA on 5,5in DP from 9,2m to 892m. Average running speed 510 m/hour. Filled pipe at 1330l/min, 3 bar

M/u TDS. Positioned cutters to cutting depth of 887m. Up/down weights 97t/90t, took parameters 75rpm 4-7knm, 300l/min 18bar, 400l/min 35bar, 500l/min 61bar. Cut CSG at 887m w/ 300l/min 21bar, 80rpm 8-12knm. Measured gap of more than 2. 7m

Flowchecked well. Observed instant gain of 300l, then loss of 3m3/hour. Then losses went to 0. Observed bubbling inside drill string and in the riser, smell of gas. M/u TDS to string and observed increase in trip tank
Closed UPR and started to circulate via fully open rig choke, performed 1x full circulation at 600-1000l/min MAX 6bar. Stopped pump and monitor via sample line. No flow
Opened UPR line up trip tank and flow checked
POOH w/ cutting BHA on 5,5in DP from 887 m to 6 m Avg. Tripping speed 705 m/hr.
Removed ps21 and installed master bushing
L/d cutting BHA. Cleaned and cleared rig floor
Performed pre-job meeting to m/u LH landing string for torque tool
P/u 1x joint of 5,5in LH DP, m/u to x-over and 1x pup joint, l/d same onto HTS. P/u and m/u tieback adapter torque tool to LH DP, RIH to 140m
P/u LH DP with x-over and pup joint, m/u TDS, engaged to tieback adapter. Applied 30 KNM clockwise torque to string and released brake in an attempt to shock tieback adapter free. No success
Performed pre-job meeting to use rig tongs
Applied 25knm counterclockwise torque with TDS and applied brake. Latched onto pipe with rig tong and pulled to MAX 50knm, observed connection above x-over broke out
Performed pre-job meeting w/ oncoming crew
Broke out TDS from pup joint and layed out joint, x-over and pup onto HTS
Evaluated situation. Meanwhile cleaned and cleared drill floor
Broke out pup joint from x-over, cleaned threads and m/u dry back to x-over to 67 KNM
P/u joint, x-over and pup joint and m/u same to string at well center
M/u TDS and trapped 25knm in string, latched rig tong and pulled to 42knm then slowly increased to 52knm
Performed pre-job meeting for changes in the plan
Attached ropes to rig tong, trapped 26knm with TDS. Pulled w/ rig tong up to 75knm on the string. Tieback adapter did not release. Meanwhile discussed with onshore organization way forward
POOH tieback adapter torque tool from 140 meter to surface. L/d same
Discussed way forward. Meanwhile performed drops check on TDS and serviced same. Troubleshoot on XP pilot pressure on BX elevator.
Started preparing milling BHA. Meanwhile continued to troubleshoot on XP pilot pressure on BX-ELEVATOR
M/u milling BHA. L/d same
P/u cutter assembly
Performed pre-job meeting for change in plans
